species.name: Crappie
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–22 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 85 ft, so fish stay above it.
